embeds.title: 🟢 Grafana Labs GitHub Breach Exposes Source Code Following TanStack Supply Chain Attack
embeds.description:
**Actor:** TeamPCP
Grafana Labs reported on May 19, 2026 that an investigation into its breach found no evidence of customer production systems being compromised. The incident was limited to the Grafana Labs GitHub environment, including public and private source code and internal repositories. The breach originated from the TanStack npm supply chain attack orchestrated by TeamPCP, which also targeted OpenAI and Mistral AI. Grafana detected the activity on May 11, 2026, after attackers exploited a missed GitHub workflow token to gain repository access. The company received an extortion demand from an unnamed threat actor on May 16 but declined to pay. Additionally, a data extortion crew named CoinbaseCartel listed Grafana Labs on its dark web site on May 15, 2026.
**Sources:** thehackernews.com • 🟢 3 corroborating
**CVEs:** none • **Access:** Compromised GitHub workflow token from TanStack npm supply chain attack
**Incident date:** 2026-05-11 • **Confidence:** confirmed
[Read source](https://thehackernews.com/2026/05/grafana-github-breach-exposes-source.html)
